name: Citi SMRT Card
highlights: 5% Savings on Online Purchases, Groceries, Taxi, Ride-hailing, SimplyGo & Malaysia Ringgit Spend
500 Min. Spend per statement month to earn max rebates
No monthly rebates cap, although rebates are capped at 600 SMRT$ per year

Minimum spend of S$500 per statement month to earn maximum rebates across groceries, online shopping, taxi rides (including private hire operators such as Grab and Gojek), SimplyGo transactions and Malaysian Ringgit Spend
Earn 5% savings on Malaysian Ringgit Spend (Applies to both eligible retail and online spend). Valid from 1 Sept 2025 to 28 Feb 2026
Earn up to 5% SMRT$ on groceries [0.3% (base rate) + 4.7% (bonus rate)]
Earn up to 5% SMRT$ on online shopping [0.3% (base rate) + 4.7% (bonus rate)]
Earn up to 5% on taxis and private hire cars [0.3% (base rate) + 4.7% (bonus rate)]
Earn up to 5% SMRT$ for SimplyGo (tap to pay) transactions [0.3% (base rate) + 4.7% (bonus rate)]
Earn 0.3% SMRT$ on all other retail spends

extra.summary: The Citi SMRT Card suits daily commuters and online shoppers seeking fuss-free rewards. Earn 5% SMRT$ rebate on groceries, online shopping, taxis, and SimplyGo and redeem SMRT$ for cash rebates to offset your spending. Rebates are capped at 600 SMRT$ annually. Consider this card if you frequently use SimplyGo and shop online.
badges: FASTER REWARD FULFILMENT | EARN UP TO 5% SMRT$

annual-interest-rate-and-fees.Minimum Monthly Repayment: Current balance if current balance is between S$0 to S$50. For current balance S$50 & above,  (i) 1% of the current balance; plus (ii) 1% of any outstanding unbilled instalment amounts; plus (iii) all interest charges (including interest charged under instalment plans); plus (iv) all upfront service fees for instalment plans; plus (v) late payment charges; or S$50 plus any overdue amounts.

our_takes.our-take: The Citi SMRT Card suits daily commuters and online shoppers seeking fuss-free rewards. While the 5% SMRT$ rebate on groceries, online shopping, taxis, SimplyGo and Malaysian Ringgit Spend is attractive, maximizing it requires a S$500 monthly spend. Rebates are capped at 600 SMRT$ annually, effectively limiting high spenders. Redeem SMRT$ for cash rebates to offset your spending. Consider this card if you frequently use SimplyGo and shop online, but weigh the spend threshold against the rebate cap.
our_takes.good-for:
Singaporeans who utilize public transportation via SimplyGo and want to earn rebates on their daily commutes.
Online shoppers seeking to maximize rewards on e-commerce purchases with no monthly rebate cap.
Budget-conscious individuals aiming to earn cashback on groceries and taxi or ride-hailing services.
our_takes.things-to-note:
Annual fees of S$196.20 apply; ensure the card's benefits outweigh the cost after waivers end.
Foreign transaction fees of 3.25% apply, so consider other options for overseas spending to save money.
27.9% annual interest rate can accrue, so it's best to pay your balances in full each month.
